votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of June 3, 2025, and July 1, 2025.
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from two prior meetings in 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 1 of 2026 with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council and Mayor jointly adopted a ceremonial resolution recognizing February 2026 as Black History Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the zoning map amendment at approximately 265 East 100 South to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: The Council continued the public hearing on a proposed rezone from MU-8 to D-1 for a property at 265 East 100 South, allowing additional time to address neighborhood concerns and design issues.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 3 of 2026, Text Amendment – Zoning Administration.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending multiple sections of Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to clarify zoning administration provisions, align the code with current practices and state law, and enhance transparency.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 4 of 2026 (Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY2025-26), approving specified items and deferring action on remaining items.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted a partial budget amendment for FY2025-26 including a pedestrian bridge, equipment purchases, police overtime funding, a Justice Court Judge appointment process, bond interest reallocation, and a one-time $50,000 legal support fund, while deferring other items.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Zach Posner as the Salt Lake City Chief Information Officer (Director of Information Management Services or IMS).
votes.description: The Council confirmed the Mayor's appointment of Zach Posner to serve as Salt Lake City's Chief Information Officer.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 3 of 2026, approving the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the Salt Lake City Library Board and The American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees Local 1004, representing eligible Library employees.
votes.description: The Council approved a collective bargaining agreement between the Salt Lake City Public Library and AFSCME Local 1004, which had been approved by the Library Board of Directors in December 2025.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for an alley/street disposition text amendment and the Northwest Pipeline Building public benefits analysis, setting a hearing date for a temporary street closure for the Temple Square 2027 reopening, and approving the appointment of Steven Cornell to the Historic Landmark Commission.
